**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). {"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. Their guarded rungs for sha-UNKNOWN (legacy) parks stay.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. Their guarded rungs for sha-UNKNOWN (legacy) parks stay.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. Their guarded rungs for sha-UNKNOWN (legacy) parks stay.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. Their guarded rungs for sha-UNKNOWN (legacy) parks stay.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. Their guarded rungs for sha-UNKNOWN (legacy) parks stay.

{"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. {"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. {"content":"# gh-994 — validation_failed label not auto-cleared on head change (park-reset broken)

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: The `validation_failed` park label survives a head change. After a kicker push / machine rework push / operator push / silent merge-main update moves the PR head, the label set for the OLD head is not removed, the SM keeps treating the PR as parked, the validation arm never re-arms, and the queue stalls until a human deletes the label (4 manual interventions on 2026-10-17 alone: 3× fa #1563, 1× fa #156).

**Root cause**: `js/smAgent.js`, `update_branch` localAction, sticky-park RESET ladder (the `if (labelsVf.indexOf(parkLabelVf) !== -1)` block, ~line 1936). The head-change reset is NOT a pure function of the current head — it is gated on re-checks of state that belongs to the old head or to probes:

1. The `#633` head-change rung (`headChangedNoVerdictVf`) only fires when the dispatched-verdict probe reports NOT `'failure'` for the new head (`probeHeadVerdictVf() !== 'failure'`). A new head that already collected a red dispatched verdict (kicker push → validation red within the same window, live fa #156) keeps the park — the reset re-checks the old state instead of firing on the head change itself.
2. The `gh-952` rung has the same verdict-probe guard plus requires `isMachinePrU` — guests with a moved head and any red-ish probe noise stay parked.
3. For machine-authored PRs (fa repo), any MACHINE push (kicker, rework leg auto-save, silent-update) that moves the head hits the `machinePushVf` HOLD branch — machine movement never clears the park (2026-09-27 contract). The gh-750 machine self-clear rung needs green-rollup / head-moved-clean probes that fail closed.
4. The human-push rung requires `parkResetCommit` + `parkedSince` probes to succeed and the push to be newer than the park event — a probe outage (gh-952 live window) or a buried/misdated actor keeps the park.

Net effect: no code path removes the label **merely because the recorded parked-head sha differs from the current `headRefOid`** — even though that is exactly what the machine's own published comment contract promises: *"Your push clears the validation_failed park via the head-change reset."*

**Impact**: Any parked PR whose head moves for any reason (the four core sources: kicker push, machine rework-leg push, operator push, merge-bot silent merge-main update) can sit parked on a stale label. validate-armed excludes the label, no validation CI is dispatched, the merge window skips the PR. Queue stalls until a human deletes the label. Live: fa #156 (kicker push 18:09Z, label persisted 20+ min), fa #1563 (operator pushes, 3×).

**Fix approach** (per the gh-994 v2 reframe — the reset becomes a pure function of the CURRENT head):

- Add a **first-position, unconditional head-change reset rung** in the ladder: when the PR carries `validation_failed` AND the park comment's recorded `parked-head` sha is known AND differs from the current head sha (full-SHA string comparison — not prefixes, not branch names; force-push and fast-forward treated identically) → remove the label. No actor probe, no park-time probe, no verdict probe. Log the audit line `park-reset: <pr> head <old>→<new>` (machine-log only, per Q2 default), drop the open-PRs cache so validate-armed re-queries the freed label the same tick, and suppress the same-pass re-park (`unparkedThisPass` already gates the SET path — a genuinely red new head is re-parked by the validation path on a later pass).
- The rung fires for every head-mutation source (it is actor-agnostic) and for guests and machine PRs alike (I2). It is idempotent and race-safe: one tick = one `removeLabel`, no re-add (I3); a remove failure is caught, logged, retried next tick (E4 degradation path — the label survives at most one extra turn).
- Legacy parks without a recorded sha fall through to the existing ladder (human-push rung, gh-750 machine self-clear) unchanged.
- The now-dead `#633` verdict-gated rung and the `gh-952` outage rung (strictly dominated by the new unconditional rung) are removed; `clearStalePark952` goes with them.
- Every machine SET path now records `parked-head: <sha>` in its park comment (fail-validation guest/convergence parks, gh-821 zombie park) so I1 holds for every machine-set park, not just the update_branch one.
- The published contract texts are made true (I4): the update_branch SET comment and the dead-head park body stop claiming "only a HUMAN push clears the park" and state the head-change reset; the fail-validation guest report already carries the correct contract sentence.

**Invariants asserted by tests**:

- I1/AC1/AC3/AC4 → new suite `smAgent: validation_failed park reset on head change (gh-994)` (unit, injected head refs, fake-API harness): kicker-style machine push with a red verdict on the new head clears; operator push on a guest clears even during a full probe outage; unchanged head keeps the park; two rules racing one tick → exactly one removal, no re-add.
- AC2 shape → the reset runs inside `update_branch`, which both the `silent-update-behind` and `park-reset` rules route through; same-tick cache drop gives validate-armed the freed label.
- AC5 (live-shape replay) → the gh-952 RED test shape (fa #1563: parked head `dd99…`, current head `cc44…`, full probe outage) now clears through the new rung.

**Previous attempt**: none (fresh bug). Precedent cards in the same ladder: #633 (verdict-gated head-change clear), gh-750 (machine self-clear), gh-952 (probe-outage exemption) — each added a guarded rung for one subset; gh-994 retracts the guard philosophy: the head-change reset is unconditional. Their guarded rungs for sha-UNKNOWN (legacy) parks stay.
